explication: Stability Matrix is a cross-platform package manager and inference UI for Stable Diffusion. The principal workflow is to install and configure a supported generation package, launch it, connect the built-in inference interface, and generate or manage images and models. The graph also preserves the README’s model browsing, shared checkpoint management, and extension-management capabilities. Several subsystems are represented at directory level because their implementation files were not sampled; those documented links cite the README rather than implying source inspection.
